description: A comprehensive JSON schema defining the operational state, capabilities, and configuration of the Monolog Studio AI 1-Person Enterprise.

environment.file_system_access: Direct, offline access to the local file system via agent actions.
environment.context_source: Local workspace files, _company directory, and GitHub repository (https://github.com/jchann00/connect-ai.git).

agent_capabilities.description: Generates new files and directories in the workspace.
Finds and replaces specific code in existing files.
Reads the content of any file in the workspace to understand context.
Lists contents of a specific subdirectory.
Executes CLI commands (e.g., npm install, node, git, ollama).
Queries the personal knowledge base (Second Brain) and company memory (_company/_shared).
